title: Meet Otto the Octopus
author: Shellfie original
credit: An original story written for Shellfie.

pages: Meet Otto the Octopus! Otto lives in the ocean, in a rocky den on the sea floor.
Otto has eight arms covered with suckers. He can even taste things with his suckers!
Otto has three hearts, and his blood is blue. He has no bones at all, so he can squeeze through a hole as small as a coin.
Otto eats crabs, clams, shrimp, and fish. He cracks open shells with a hard beak, like a parrot's.
Otto can change his color and the bumps on his skin in less than a second. He can look like a rock, sand, or a piece of coral.
Sharks, eels, and seals like to eat octopuses. If one comes near, Otto squirts a cloud of dark ink and zooms away.
Octopuses are very smart. One day a diver dropped a jar with a crab inside. Otto twisted off the lid and ate the crab.
Then he put the jar on his head like a hat and swam around to show off.
Octopuses like to live alone. Otto keeps his den tidy and piles shells by the door, like a little fence.
